A '''bucket''' is an iron item. [[Matcha Flavoured]] replaces its recipe with one that gives more when made from steel.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
3 iron ingots make 1 bucket, as in vanilla; 3 [[Steel Alloy|steel alloy]] make 4. The vanilla recipe is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/bucket_from_iron.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>
